detail.en: The App Store iOS app, built with Expo and Expo Router. Face ID locks it, and everyday updates ship over the air with EAS — no new review needed.
detail.zh: 以 Expo + Expo Router 開發、已上架 App Store 的 iOS App，可用 Face ID 鎖定；日常更新透過 EAS OTA 推送，不必每次重新送審。

detail.en: The Next.js 15 web app. It lives in the same Turborepo as the iOS app and shares its API, Zod schemas and Clerk auth.
detail.zh: Next.js 15 + React 19 的網頁版，和 iOS App 放在同一個 Turborepo，共用 API、Zod schema 與 Clerk 認證。

detail.en: Both apps sign in through Clerk OAuth. The web app carries a session cookie, the iOS app a Bearer token — the backend trusts one identity either way.
detail.zh: 兩端都用 Clerk 處理 OAuth 登入：網頁帶 session cookie、iOS App 帶 Bearer token，後端只認同一種身分。

detail.en: Premium is an in-app subscription on iOS, handled by RevenueCat. PostHog breaks down the paywall funnel.
detail.zh: iOS 的 Premium 訂閱以 RevenueCat 串接 App Store 內購，並用 PostHog 拆解付費漏斗。

detail.en: When a subscription starts, renews or lapses, App Store Server Notifications post a JWS-signed webhook to the API, which updates the Subscription table — the app never reports its own status.
detail.zh: 訂閱開通、續訂或取消時，App Store Server Notifications 以 JWS 簽章的 webhook 通知後端，寫進 Subscription 表；訂閱狀態不靠 App 自己回報。

detail.en: Every request first passes clerkMiddleware, which verifies the session with Clerk and keeps signed-out calls away from the API with auth.protect().
detail.zh: 每個請求先經過 clerkMiddleware，向 Clerk 驗證 session，以 auth.protect() 把未登入的請求擋在 API 之外。

detail.en: Each Route Handler calls auth() again and returns 401 without a userId. Request bodies are checked against Zod schemas the web and iOS apps share.
detail.zh: 每個 Route Handler 再自行呼叫 auth()，拿不到 userId 就回 401；請求內容以 Zod schema 驗證，網頁與 App 共用同一份 schema。

note.en:
Business logic
scoped to each userId
note.zh:
商業邏輯
每筆以 userId 隔離

detail.en: The business logic lives in one Services layer, and every query carries the userId — one user's data can never show up for another.
detail.zh: 商業邏輯集中在 Services 層，每一筆查詢都帶著 userId，使用者之間的資料不可能互相看到。

detail.en: PostgreSQL on Supabase, modelled with 10 Prisma models — from assets and debts to holdings and subscription state.
detail.zh: 資料放在 Supabase 的 PostgreSQL，以 Prisma 設計 10 個資料模型，資產、負債、持股到訂閱狀態都在這裡。

detail.en: The backend fetches Taiwan and US quotes and exchange rates over HTTPS from Yahoo, TWSE, Finnhub and others, so overseas holdings convert to TWD.
detail.zh: 後端以 HTTPS 向 Yahoo、TWSE、Finnhub 等來源取得台美股報價與匯率，海外持股自動換算成台幣。

detail.en: Starting from today's net worth, it projects how far you are from your retirement goal.
detail.zh: 從目前的淨資產出發，推算距離退休目標還有多遠。

detail.en: Assets, debts and multi-currency holdings from every bank and broker, valued live and added up — the full picture of net worth in one place.
detail.zh: 把各家銀行、券商的資產、負債與多幣別持股，依即時市值彙整在一起，終於看得到淨資產全貌。

detail.en: The long-term cash flow from dividends and insurance policies, with overseas dividends converted at the current rate.
detail.zh: 整理股利與保單帶來的長期現金流，海外股息依匯率換算。

detail.en: A Vite-built PWA that installs to the home screen, with one-tap Google sign-in.
detail.zh: 以 Vite 打造的網頁 PWA，可加到主畫面，Google 一鍵登入。

detail.en: The web UI ported 1:1 to an Expo app, on the App Store since 2026/08/19, with Sign in with Apple.
detail.zh: 把網頁 UI 1:1 移植成 Expo App，2026/08/19 上架 App Store，支援 Sign in with Apple。

detail.en: Both apps sign in with Clerk; the backend verifies the Clerk JWT's signature, so each user can only reach their own data.
detail.zh: 兩端都用 Clerk 登入，後端驗證 Clerk JWT 的簽章，確保每位使用者只能存取自己的資料。

detail.en: Snap a meal and n8n hands the photo to AI to recognise the food and estimate calories — one step fewer, so logging lasts.
detail.zh: 拍下餐點，由 n8n 串接 AI 辨識食物並估算熱量；少一個手動步驟，記錄才容易持續。

detail.en: Search the imported Taiwan FDA nutrition data — it has the food people here actually eat. Favourites go into a personal food library.
detail.zh: 搜尋匯入的食藥署營養資料，查得到台灣人常吃的食物；常吃的也能存進個人食物庫。

detail.en: A FastAPI backend handles every read and write, scoped to the user in the JWT, and runs in Docker on Zeabur.
detail.zh: FastAPI 後端處理所有讀寫，依 JWT 的使用者身分隔離資料，以 Docker 部署在 Zeabur。

detail.en: PostgreSQL holds over a thousand Taiwanese foods from the FDA dataset and everyone's meal logs, accessed through SQLAlchemy.
detail.zh: PostgreSQL 存放上千筆食藥署台灣食物營養資料與每個人的飲食紀錄，以 SQLAlchemy 存取。

detail.en: Each logged meal adds up the day's calories and its protein, fat and carbs.
detail.zh: 每記下一餐，就自動加總當日熱量與蛋白質、脂肪、碳水三大營養素。

detail.en: A yearly trend chart shows how intake moves over the long run.
detail.zh: 以年度趨勢圖看長期的熱量變化。

detail.en: Rings show at a glance how much of each nutrient today has had.
detail.zh: 以環圈一眼看出今天各營養素吃了多少。

detail.en: The organiser signs in with Clerk before setting up a session.
detail.zh: 主揪以 Clerk 登入後，才能建立活動、安排場次。

detail.en: Tick off who showed up today, with search and a gender filter — the dark, stage-style picker I redesigned.
detail.zh: 從球友名單勾選今天到場的人，可搜尋、依性別篩選；這是我重構的深色舞台風格選人畫面。

detail.en: Set how many courts and rounds there are — the constraints the schedule is built from.
detail.zh: 設定今天有幾面場地、要打幾場，作為排賽程的條件。

note.en:
≤ 1 woman per pair
≤ 2 games on or off in a row
note.zh:
每隊女生最多 1 名
連上／連休不超過 2 場

detail.en: Generates 2v2 rotations by rule: at most one woman per team, no one plays or sits out more than two rounds in a row, and repeat pairings are avoided.
detail.zh: 依規則自動產生 2v2 輪替：每隊最多一名女生、不連續上場或休息超過兩場，並盡量避免重複搭配。

detail.en: A schedule across several courts at once; one tap reshuffles it.
detail.zh: 產出多面場地同時進行的賽程，不滿意可一鍵重排。

detail.en: The schedule gets a code to drop into the group chat.
detail.zh: 賽程產生後得到一組代號，傳到群組就能分享給球友。

detail.en: Players enter the code — no sign-up needed.
detail.zh: 球友不用註冊，輸入主揪給的代號就能加入。

detail.en: Players see who's on next from their phones, synced every 3 seconds.
detail.zh: 球友在手機上即時看到輪到誰上場，每 3 秒同步一次。

detail.en: After sign-in, the home page and research are tailored to the user's industry.
detail.zh: 登入後依使用者的產業別，個人化首頁與研究內容。

note.zh:
新聞・論文
開源・新創

detail.en: Signals scattered across news, papers, open-source communities and startup data — gathered by hand before.
detail.zh: 散落在新聞、論文、開源社群與新創資料裡的訊號，原本只能人工蒐集。

detail.en: Signals sorted on a STEEP map (social, technological, economic, environmental, political), telling a fresh weak signal from a mainstream trend.
detail.zh: 以 STEEP（社會、科技、經濟、環境、政治）架構把訊號整理成趨勢圖譜，分辨剛冒出的弱信號與已成主流的趨勢。

detail.en: From a trend to the leaders driving it: a radar of key people and organisations in the field.
detail.zh: 從趨勢延伸到推動它的人：追蹤各領域關鍵領袖與機構的雷達。

detail.en: A board matching trends with relevant startups.
detail.zh: 把趨勢對應到相關新創的媒合看板。

detail.en: Start a deep research run on a topic; the report streams in through an SSE proxy that injects heartbeats while upstream is idle, so the gateway never drops it.
detail.zh: 針對題目發起深度研究，報告透過 SSE 串流代理即時呈現；上游閒置時注入 heartbeat，避免閘道斷線。

detail.en: The technology portfolio decision centre: a fishbone chart works back from a goal to the technology it needs, and a Delphi round gathers expert judgement.
detail.zh: 技術投資組合決策中心：以魚骨圖從目標回推需要的技術，再以 Delphi 法彙整專家評估。

detail.en: A signed share code opens a read-only report page without sign-in, and the link can't be tampered with.
detail.zh: 以簽章分享碼產生免登入的報告分享頁，連結無法被竄改。

detail.en: A daily AI newsletter delivers what's new.
detail.zh: 每日 AI 電子報，把新動態主動送到使用者手上。

detail.en: Branding, speech-to-text, sign-in, knowledge-base editing and API endpoints are all switched by environment variables.
detail.zh: 品牌樣式、語音轉文字、登入、知識庫是否可編輯與 API 端點，全部由環境變數控制。

detail.en: One codebase, live as six venue brands — a planetarium, Lee Teng-hui, the Yongzheng Emperor, Einstein and more — plus a shared contract version.
detail.zh: 同一套程式碼已上線天文館、李登輝、雍正帝、愛因斯坦等 6 個場館品牌，另有一個共同契約版本。

detail.en: Each venue's guide knowledge, editable by staff when the settings allow.
detail.zh: 每個場館的導覽知識庫，依設定決定是否開放管理者編輯。

detail.en: Visitors come in with a guest sign-in — no account needed.
detail.zh: 訪客進站後以訪客身分登入，不需要註冊帳號。

detail.en: Type, or just speak — multilingual speech-to-text turns the voice into a question.
detail.zh: 可以打字，也可以直接說話；多語語音轉文字把語音轉成提問。

detail.en: The chat UI dressed in the venue's brand; CSP headers decide which domains may embed it.
detail.zh: 依品牌設定套上樣式的聊天介面，以 CSP 標頭控管哪些網域可以嵌入。

detail.en: The LLM answers from what it retrieves in the knowledge base, streaming word by word instead of waiting for the whole reply.
detail.zh: 從知識庫檢索相關內容後由 LLM 回答，逐字串流顯示，不必等整段生成完。

detail.en: Every answer cites its sources, so visitors can check where it came from.
detail.zh: 每則回答附上引用來源，訪客可以確認資訊出處。

detail.en: Speech synthesis reads the answer aloud.
detail.zh: 以語音合成把回答朗讀出來。

detail.en: Translations are kept so visitors can look back at them.
detail.zh: 保存翻譯紀錄，方便回頭查看。

detail.en: Crawlers on a schedule pull in public data.
detail.zh: 設定爬蟲排程，定期抓取外部公開資料。

note.zh: 公司登記・櫃買・補助

detail.en: Company registry, TPEx and subsidy data imported in one place — no more cross-checking three sources.
detail.zh: 匯入公司登記、櫃買中心與補助資料，不必再在三處之間來回比對。

detail.en: Taiwan's IT service companies, merged with their industry classes and products and services.
detail.zh: 整合後的台灣資訊服務業企業資料，含產業分類與產品服務。

note.en:
Capital, headcount, subsidies
Jotai atoms per condition
note.zh:
資本額・員工數・補助
Jotai 原子化狀態

detail.en: Filter by capital, headcount, capability registration, subsidies and product category. Each filter is its own Jotai atom, so changing one doesn't recompute the whole graph.
detail.zh: 依資本額、員工數、能量登錄、獲補助紀錄、產品類別等條件篩選；狀態以 Jotai 拆成原子，任一條件變動不會重算整張圖。

detail.en: Describe what you need in conversation to find companies — another way in besides the filters.
detail.zh: 用對話描述需求來找企業，是篩選之外的另一條路。

detail.en: Matching companies, grouped by industry field.
detail.zh: 符合條件的企業，依產業領域分類列出。

detail.en: One company's profile, products and services, and subsidy history.
detail.zh: 單一企業的基本資料、產品服務與補助紀錄。

detail.en: Cytoscape.js draws the investment and shareholding ties between companies.
detail.zh: 以 Cytoscape.js 畫出企業之間的投資與持股關係。

detail.en: Describe in plain words what the AI agent should do.
detail.zh: 用白話描述想要的 AI Agent 要做什麼。

detail.en: The Architect module reads the request and generates the agent's setup.
detail.zh: 「架構師」模組讀取需求後，自動生成 Agent 的設定。

detail.en: Upload several documents to the knowledge base at once.
detail.zh: 一次上傳多份文件到知識庫。

detail.en: The knowledge base takes documents and can build a SQL database, wiring agents into a company's own data.
detail.zh: 知識庫支援文件與建立 SQL 資料庫，讓 Agent 接上自家的資料。

detail.en: A generated agent, now grounded in the knowledge base.
detail.zh: 生成好、已接上知識的 AI Agent。

detail.en: The Studio combines several agents into one application.
detail.zh: 「工作室」把多個 Agent 組合成一個應用。

detail.en: The assembled AI application, ready to use.
detail.zh: 組合完成、可以直接使用的 AI 應用。

detail.en: Record a voice message instead of typing.
detail.zh: 按下錄音，直接用語音輸入。

note.zh:
Markdown・程式碼
圖片・影音

detail.en: Messages render Markdown, highlighted code, images and video. I split the large Chat component into focused sub-components to keep it maintainable.
detail.zh: 訊息支援 Markdown、程式碼高亮與圖片、影音渲染；我把大型 Chat 元件拆成獨立子元件，維護起來更容易。

detail.en: Each month the accountant scans the carers' handwritten timesheets to PDF.
detail.zh: 會計每月把照顧服務員的手寫工作表掃描成 PDF。

detail.en: The accountant doesn't code — a double-click on a batch file starts everything.
detail.zh: 會計不會寫程式，只要點兩下批次檔就開始。

detail.en: Claude reads the scans step by step, following a custom skill.
detail.zh: Claude 依自訂 skill 的步驟，逐份讀取掃描檔。

label.zh:
每位看護員
一份 JSON

detail.en: Each carer becomes one structured JSON file for the calculation engine.
detail.zh: 每位看護員整理成一份結構化 JSON，交給計費引擎。

detail.en: An ID-number lookup corrects names the AI misread.
detail.zh: 以身分證對照表更正 AI 讀錯的姓名。

detail.en: A Python engine splits shifts by the billing rules into days, shifts and sessions with amounts. Checked against September's hand-made report: 78 rows, every cell matching.
detail.zh: Python 計費引擎依規則切時段，算出日／班／節與金額；以 115 年 9 月人工報表驗算，78 筆逐格一致。

detail.en: What the rules can't settle goes on a to-confirm list; the accountant just answers Claude in Chinese.
detail.zh: 規則判斷不了的地方列成待確認清單，會計用中文回答 Claude 的問題即可。

detail.en: Excel COM copies last month's layout to produce the new month's report.
detail.zh: 以 Excel COM 複製上個月的格式，產出新月份報表。

detail.en: A preview PDF to check, then print.
detail.zh: 產出預覽 PDF，確認後列印。

lanes.en: 1. On this computer — free, nothing uploaded
lanes.zh: 1. 本機處理（免費、音檔不上傳）

detail.en: Drop in an episode of up to 60 minutes. Everything runs locally — the audio never leaves the computer.
detail.zh: 丟入一集 60 分鐘內的音檔，全程在本機處理，音檔不上傳。

detail.en: FFmpeg prepares the audio, then faster-whisper transcribes it.
detail.zh: 以 FFmpeg 前處理，再用 faster-whisper 做語音辨識。

detail.en: pyannote works out who is speaking, so the transcript is labelled by speaker.
detail.zh: 以 pyannote 分辨誰在說話，逐字稿標好講者。

detail.en: OpenCC converts to Traditional Chinese, and a custom glossary fixes the show's recurring names and terms.
detail.zh: 以 OpenCC 簡轉繁，再用自訂詞庫校正節目常用的專有名詞。

detail.en: Out come an .srt subtitle file and a speaker-labelled transcript.
detail.zh: 產出 .srt 字幕與標好講者的逐字稿。

detail.en: Only the text goes to Claude, which writes the title, description, chapters and quotes to the show's style guide skill. A side-by-side with a local Qwen model settled on Claude.
detail.zh: 只把文字交給 Claude，依自訂 skill 寫成的節目規範撰寫標題、描述、章節與金句；曾與本機 Qwen 並排比較，最後統一用 Claude。

note.en:
Times, quotes, numbers
must match the transcript
note.zh:
章節時間・金句・數字
都要對得上逐字稿

detail.en: Chapter times, quotes and numbers are checked against the transcript; only a clean pass is output.
detail.zh: 自動檢查章節時間、金句與數字都對得上逐字稿，全部通過才輸出。

detail.en: Subtitles, transcript and copy in hand, the episode goes live.
detail.zh: 字幕、逐字稿與文案齊全，上架節目。

detail.en: Listeners arrive from the show; the site is built mobile-first.
detail.zh: 聽眾從節目連結進入官網，以手機版體驗為主。

detail.en: A personality quiz whose result depends on the combination of answers.
detail.zh: 一份心理測驗，結果依作答組合而定。

detail.en: Each answer combination gets its own share card, downloadable at 1080×1350 for social media.
detail.zh: 依作答組合產生專屬分享小卡，可下載 1080×1350 圖片分享到社群。

detail.en: "Letters in the Sea" takes listener submissions, alongside a private message box for the podcast.
detail.zh: 「大海裡的信」讓聽眾投稿，另有不公開的 Podcast 留言箱。

detail.en: Submissions are stored in Upstash Redis, rate-limited and guarded against bots.
detail.zh: 投稿存進 Upstash Redis，並做限流與防機器人。

detail.en: Each new submission is pushed to Discord, so the hosts see it right away.
detail.zh: 新投稿即時推送到 Discord，主持人馬上收到。

detail.en: CLAUDE.md records the project's conventions, so Claude Code starts every session on the same rules.
detail.zh: CLAUDE.md 記下開發慣例，Claude Code 每次開工都照同一套規則。

detail.en: Claude Code rebuilt the layout, spacing and interactions from measurements of the reference design.
detail.zh: 由 Claude Code 依參考設計的實測值，重現版型、間距與互動。

detail.en: Claude Code hooks block badly formatted commits and PRs opened from the main branch.
detail.zh: Claude Code hooks 擋下格式不符的 commit 與從主分支開的 PR。

detail.en: Deployed on Vercel.
detail.zh: 部署在 Vercel 上線。

detail.en: An llms.txt helps AI search understand the site.
detail.zh: 提供 llms.txt，讓 AI 搜尋讀懂網站內容。

detail.en: /planning:spec interviews for requirements and turns them into a spec.
detail.zh: 以 /planning:spec 訪談需求，整理成規格文件。

note.zh:
spec-autopilot
自行決定待定問題

detail.en: spec-autopilot makes the AI check its own spec for gaps and settle every open question before handing it over.
detail.zh: spec-autopilot 讓 AI 交出規格前先自我檢查缺漏，並自行決定所有待定問題。

detail.en: /planning:review reviews the plan as a staff engineer would — PASS, WARN or FAIL — and /planning:apply-review folds in the fixes.
detail.zh: /planning:review 以 Staff 工程師的角度審查，給出 PASS／WARN／FAIL，再用 /planning:apply-review 修正，定案計畫。

detail.en: /git:branch starts a new branch from main.
detail.zh: 以 /git:branch 從 main 開新分支。

note.en:
Failing test first,
then the code
note.zh:
先寫失敗測試
再寫程式

detail.en: Write a failing test first, then the code that passes it.
detail.zh: 先寫失敗的測試，再寫讓它通過的程式。

detail.en: OWASP, the design system and API conventions written as skills, so the AI works to the same standard every time.
detail.zh: 把 OWASP、設計系統與 API 規範寫成 skills，AI 每次都照同一套標準。

note.zh:
敏感檔・commit 格式
PR 分支

detail.en: Hooks check every write, blocking sensitive files, badly formatted commits and PRs from the wrong branch.
detail.zh: 每次寫檔都由 hooks 檢查，擋下敏感檔、不合格式的 commit 與從錯誤分支開的 PR。

note.zh:
lint・型別・測試
通過才算完成

detail.en: A Stop hook runs lint, type checks and tests; Claude may only call it done when all pass.
detail.zh: Stop hook 跑完 lint、型別檢查與測試，全部通過 Claude 才能宣告完成。

detail.en: /create-pr opens a PR to develop, where Claude Code Review checks it in CI.
detail.zh: 以 /create-pr 開 PR 到 develop，在 CI 由 Claude Code Review 審查。
